note: Attacker-controlled key bytes from the database bucket entry are passed into the validity check.
The key hash is computed; for key bytes 0x00 0x11 the resulting bucket index is 255, which exceeds the crafted directory count.
The recomputed hash matches the stored bucket entry hash, so the second condition is evaluated.
dbf->dir[bucket] is read with bucket=255. The crafted dir_size=2040 makes GDBM_DIR_COUNT=255, so index 255 is out of bounds (the dir array holds only 255 entries), causing an out-of-bounds heap read.
gdbm_valid_key_p is invoked from get_next_key during gdbm_firstkey/gdbm_nextkey sequential access, reaching the OOB read.
